## v0.1.4 — Mouse look + remaps + Saw launcher

Fresh Windows x64 package. **BYO ISO** — no game files inside.

### Changes
- Mouse look (MnK) without fighting arrow-key right-stick binds
- Remappable keyboard binds in the launcher (grouped controls)
- Higher base mouse→stick gain for this UE3 title (pad / joystick unchanged)
- Sensitivity slider range widened; defaults tuned for Saw 2
- Saw-themed launcher palette

### What's included
- Saw2Launcher.exe
- saw2.exe + RelWithDebInfo runtime DLLs
- extract-xiso.exe
- README.txt / BUILD.txt

### You need
- Own Saw II Xbox 360 ISO (`4B4E0822`)
- .NET 8 Desktop Runtime
- Vulkan-capable GPU (D3D12 present path)
